preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 10000 for N in N_values)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of vertices N is between 2 and 10,000.
For each test case, the number of vertices N is even.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: For each edge (u, v), both u and v are between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == N - 1 for edges in edge_lists)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of edges is exactly N-1, forming a tree.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly three lines for each test case.
The first line of each test case contains a single integer.
The second line of each test case contains N/2 space-separated integers.
The third line of each test case contains N/2 space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(set(output_lines[i+1].strip().split()) & set(output_lines[i+2].strip().split()) == set() for i in range(0, 3*T, 3))
postconditions.description: The sets U and V are disjoint.
The union of sets U and V contains all N vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(u) in range(1, N_values[i//3] + 1) and int(v) in range(1, N_values[i//3] + 1) for u, v in zip(output_lines[i+1].strip().split(), output_lines[i+2].strip().split())) for i in range(0, 3*T, 3))
postconditions.description: All vertices in U and V are within the range [1, N].
